$comment: check:deck-deps (#363 part B, owner 2026-11-03: 'those that shouldnt will fail if the native deck is properly encapsulated'): the core crates of deck/ and the features they are checked with; every crate in their normal dependency tree (cargo tree, all targets) must be in `allow` with a reason, none may be in `deny` (a platform library: audio, window, GPU, sockets, MIDI / serial / input devices, an async runtime, HTTP). A platform need is an adapter crate's (deck-native, space-web, bridge, relay, the adapters) – never a core crate's. `exceptions` are the justified ones: the feature that pulls a platform library and why it stays. `tools` are workspace crates that are tools, not core (benches): listed so nobody takes them for core crates, not checked.

crates.why: the node-kind catalog: ports, domains, ranges
maths, F8 lanes, DSP units, tempo, analysis (default features)
the scene model, rig, quality governor, controls and the being without its GPU passes or file loaders
the audio engine with every feature but the module JIT
the module host without its JIT backend
parameters as outputs without the adapters' runner
the engine behind the browser's raw wasm exports (the adapter API the headless host drives)
the headless deck host (#363): the third adapter, platform-free by construction
the Live outlet's logic (#378): a cell's plan, the composer, the crossfade, the dialog / text layout, the relay messages' routing
the deck's UI model (#374): the HUD's lines, the stats bar's items, the F1 mode

tools.why: the module runtime benchmark (#306, agents/research/MODULE-BENCH.md): not a core crate and not checked here – wasmi, wasm-instrument, wasm-encoder live in this tool only; no production crate depends on it
the same suite as a raw wasm for a browser / Node worker (#306)
#306's FM workload (sixteen voices), a bench module – not a factory module
#306's runaway loop and memory growth, a bench module

exceptions.why: the being's GPU passes – wgpu is itself the GPU adapter both platforms share (Vulkan / Metal / DX12 natively, WebGPU / WebGL2 in space-web); the core part is checked without it
the set / portrait loaders from files on a deck; the browser decodes images itself – checked without it
the native module backend is a JIT (no audio, window, GPU or socket); the browser runs modules on its own wasm engine – checked without it
the runner that plays outputs through the bridge's adapters – a platform part inside the crate behind a feature; #378-style split later

deny.wasmtime: a JIT runtime (the native module backend)
deny.symphonia: media decoding (deck-media later, behind an adapter)

allow.ab_glyph: deck-space being: the labels' font maths; deck-outlet: the dialog / text layout (CPU)
allow.image: deck-space being: resizing and mip levels (no decoders without `native`); deck-outlet: the plane, crops, scaling, overlays (no decoders)
allow.libc: via cpufeatures (aarch64 Linux reads the CPU features from getauxval) – no I/O
allow.libm: portable maths (the same bits on every target)
allow.protocol: the relay protocol's serde types (generated; no I/O)
allow.rtrb: a lock-free ring (the control half's command / snapshot rings)
allow.tracing: log macros (the adapter installs the subscriber)
